entities.name: Extended DRX parameters
entities.description: An information element that the UE may include to request the use of extended DRX (eDRX) parameters.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that may include the Extended DRX parameters IE to request eDRX usage.

entities.name: eDRX usage request
entities.description: The condition where the UE requests to use extended DRX parameters by including the corresponding IE.

relations.description: The UE may include the Extended DRX parameters IE in a message.
Inclusion of the Extended DRX parameters IE indicates a request to use eDRX.
